lessons.title: Open the curtain
body: Every sound on this synth starts bright and buzzy. The filter is a curtain in front of it: the cutoff knob decides how far the curtain opens.
Low cutoff, dark and muffled. High cutoff, bright and open. Play a note, sweep the knob slowly, and listen to the curtain move.

goal.hint: Make it open like a curtain - clearly bright, but not fully wide.

lessons.title: The wah in the wire
body: Resonance is a megaphone pointed at the exact spot where the curtain opens. It makes that edge whistle and sing.
A little resonance sounds like a wah pedal. A lot sounds like a siren. Find the spot where the sound starts to speak.

goal.hint: Give it a clear, vocal wah - singing, not screaming.

lessons.title: The contour's hand
body: The filter contour is an invisible hand on the cutoff knob. Every note, it gives the knob one quick turn, then settles back.
Contour amount decides how big that turn is. Zero: the hand stays home. High: each note starts with a bite, then mellows.

goal.hint: Each note should bite, then relax - a pluck, not a drone.
